colorExceptions: User-selected colors stored in the database
transparent, currentColor, inherit and functional alpha states

display.purpose: Compact page context, never marketing hero copy.

body.purpose: Navigation, forms, explanations, and data labels.

label.purpose: Sentence-case labels and compact table metadata.

tabLabel.purpose: Persistent one-word labels in the compact bottom navigation; fixed at 11px.

shadows.name: floating-overlay
shadows.purpose: Light-mode overlays only; dark mode uses surface lightness.

shadows.name: sidebar-raised
shadows.purpose: Short directional depth for sidebar controls; dark mode uses neutral-950.

shadows.name: sidebar-inset
shadows.purpose: Pressed navigation and recessed theme controls.

shadows.name: content-plane
shadows.purpose: One raised desktop plane for every authenticated route; dark mode uses neutral-700 and neutral-950.

shadows.name: raised-panel
shadows.purpose: Short depth for self-contained primary panels only; nested structures remain flat.

shadows.name: mobile-liquid-dock
shadows.purpose: The single floating navigation layer below 64rem; backdrop blur is capability-driven and never nested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary-600 in light mode and Primary-400 in dark mode with an adjacent ramp hover state.

components.name: Match Row
components.description: Neutral surface with Primary points, Warning Joker state and semantic status colors.

components.name: Mobile Liquid Dock
components.description: Four persistent top-level tabs on one Regular Liquid Glass surface with an opaque accessibility fallback.

narrative.overview: A restrained product palette: neutral surfaces, Primary actions, Secondary navigation and strictly semantic Success, Warning and Error states.
keyCharacteristics: One capability-driven Liquid Glass mobile navigation layer
Player colors and club logos remain domain exceptions

rules.name: Closed Palette
rules.body: Every UI, status, table-zone and categorical chart color comes from one of the six documented ramps.

rules.name: Meaning Before Decoration
rules.body: Color identifies action, selection, category or status and never acts as unmotivated decoration.

rules.name: One Inter
rules.body: Inter is the only font family across the interface.

rules.name: Layered Navigation
rules.body: Desktop uses the collapsible sidebar; below 64rem the same four URL-addressable destinations remain visible in a persistent bottom tab bar.

rules.name: Single Glass Layer
rules.body: Backdrop blur is reserved for one mobile navigation dock. Tabs, sheets and content never stack another glass effect above it, and opaque accessibility fallbacks are mandatory.

rules.name: Two-Level Content
rules.body: The desktop content plane and self-contained primary panels are the only persistent content elevations; rows, cells and form groups stay flat.

rules.name: Route Titles
rules.body: Every H1 names the active navigation destination; matchday, season and status remain supporting context.

rules.name: Table Ownership
rules.body: The outer panel owns radius and elevation. Tables remain flat with muted headers, neutral row hover and compact legend-matched rank markers instead of side stripes.

rules.name: Filled vs Readable
rules.body: Filled semantic tokens use their foreground partners; colored text on neutral surfaces uses the stronger primary-, success- or error-readable token, while control-border remains stronger than structural border.
